publication: FELIS MUNDI — Cats Around the World
identity_core: Shot on Leica M11, 50mm f/1.4 Summilux, Kodak Portra 400 analog color grade, natural window and ambient sunlight, subtle organic 35mm film grain, zero text, zero watermarks, zero borders.

plates.caption: A calico watches the evening ferry crossing between Europe and Asia from a weathered limestone parapet.
plates.subject: Calico street cat at golden hour overlooking the Bosphorus and Ottoman domes

plates.caption: Midday stillness on a cedar pavement table beside a tulip glass of black tea in Cihangir.
plates.subject: Marmalade tabby sleeping beside a Turkish tea glass on a cobblestone alley table

plates.caption: A Japanese Bobtail keeps watch on rain-darkened granite steps between vermilion torii pillars.
plates.subject: White-and-tortoiseshell Japanese Bobtail on mossy Kyoto shrine steps in morning mist

plates.caption: Afternoon heat softens into limestone shade beneath salt-weathered cobalt shutters.
plates.subject: Silver-cream tabby asleep on stone wall against peeling blue wooden shutters
